conversion_funnel.title: Conversion Funnel
conversion_funnel.query:
SELECT 
                'Destination Card Clicked' as step,
                count(DISTINCT user_id) as users
            FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 
                'Application Started' as step,
                count(DISTINCT user_id) as users
            FROM atlys.application_started
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 
                'Document Uploaded' as step,
                count(DISTINCT user_id) as users
            FROM atlys.document_uploaded
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 
                'Purchase Completed' as step,
                count(DISTINCT user_id) as users
            FROM atlys.purchase_completed
conversion_funnel.description: User conversion through the purchase funnel

metric_conversion_rate.title: Conversion Rate
metric_conversion_rate.query: SELECT round(100 * (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM atlys.purchase_completed) / (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked), 2)

destination_card_clicked_by_device_type.title: destination_card_clicked by device_type
destination_card_clicked_by_device_type.query:
SELECT 
                device_type as segment,
                count(DISTINCT user_id) as users,
                count() as events
            FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked
            WHERE device_type IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY device_type
            ORDER BY users DESC
            LIMIT 20

destination_card_clicked_events_over_tim.title: count() over time (destination_card_clicked)
destination_card_clicked_events_over_tim.query:
SELECT 
                toStartOfHour(timestamp) as hour,
                count() as value
            FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked
            WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
            ORDER BY hour
destination_card_clicked_events_over_tim.description: Time series of count() from destination_card_clicked

destination_card_clicked_heatmap_device_.title: Heatmap: device_type vs geoip_country_code (destination_card_clicked)
destination_card_clicked_heatmap_device_.query:
SELECT 
                device_type as x,
                geoip_country_code as y,
                count(DISTINCT user_id) as users
            FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked
            WHERE device_type IS NOT NULL AND geoip_country_code IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY device_type, geoip_country_code
            ORDER BY users DESC

application_started_heatmap_funnel_type_.title: Heatmap: funnel_type vs device_type (application_started)
application_started_heatmap_funnel_type_.query:
SELECT 
                funnel_type as x,
                device_type as y,
                count(DISTINCT user_id) as users
            FROM atlys.application_started
            WHERE funnel_type IS NOT NULL AND device_type IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY funnel_type, device_type
            ORDER BY users DESC
